_comment: Full roster incl. Burp, in native pi (>=1.4) format. To use it instead of the baked default, point pi-ctf at it: PI_MCP_SRC=/workspace/mcp.full.example.json pi-ctf (copy this file into /workspace first), or drop it in a trusted project as .pi/mcp.json. Burp's MCP server runs INSIDE Burp Suite on your HOST (PortSwigger/mcp-server, default SSE http://127.0.0.1:9876/sse). For the sandbox to reach it you must (1) have Burp running with the MCP extension enabled, and (2) open that port from br-pi in firewall.sh (currently only 8080 is allowed). exposure/description/toolExposure are documented in pi-ext/mcp.json.

keel.description: Scoped pentest control plane: define engagement scope and run allow-listed security tooling within it.

pentest.description: General penetration-testing tools: reconnaissance, port/service scanning, and enumeration.

cyber.description: Unified offensive-security toolkit: network, web, and host scanning utilities.

burp.description: Burp Suite (host): proxy history, scanner, repeater and intruder over the Burp MCP extension.
